tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rig byed ma'i rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag tshar chen yab sras kyi phyag bzhes zab don 'khrul med bzhugs so// swasti/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas khang phyags dar skyang nur la sogs pa byas te/ rten 'gram pa dang / chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang zlum gtor dmar po bshams la/ tsan phye dmar pos byug pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bras tshom dmar po gcig bkod/ rdor dril nang mchod 'thor nas rnams bsham mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ gnas yo byin rlabs kyai rdor ltar byas la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes tshar bdun la sogs pa brjod/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i bsgom bzlas kyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang nyid skad cig gis ku ru kul+le zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i snying khar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrī dmar po las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs kyi ri ku ru kul+le'i gnas dang phyogs bcu'i zhing nas rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le bla ma 'od dpag med kyis gtsug na brgyan pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzāḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ thar mo sbyar nas/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma shrī ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ gu ru shrī ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/

pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar lan gsum gyis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig zhes tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams su raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur dang bcas pa'i phyi rol kun du ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la gnas pa'i ro'i snying gar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥdamar po las/ ut+pa la dmar po'i lte bar hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le ye shes kyi sku can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ rgya skyegs kyi me tog ltar dmar zhing snum pa zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yon du g.yo ba/ dbu skra khams ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi thod pa skam po lngas brgyan cing /

rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis ut+pal dmar po'i myu gu'i mda' me tog kha bye la khad pa mde'u'i tshul dang / ut+pal dmar po'i gzhu gzhu rgyud dang sbyar te rna ba'i drung du 'gengs pa g.yas 'og mas ut+pal dmar po'i lcags kyu dang / g.yon 'og mas ut+pal dmar po'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ chu 'dzin dang 'o 'dzin rab tu rgyas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs can/ khro ba dang gegs pa'i nyams can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis 'gying zhing / chags pa'i nyams kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying ga nas nyi ma la gnas pa'i ut+pal dmar po'i bar nyi ma'i dbus su hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho phyogs kyi ri ku ru kul+le'i phug nas rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ shrī ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes sogs kyis gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya ut+pal la'i tshul du chag lo gsum pas mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi man ngag las/ ut+pa la'i phyag rgya ni/ lag pa thal mo sbyar la/ mthe'u chung bsnol/ gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar/ ming med gnyis nang du bkug mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar/ mthe bong gnyis nang du gung mo la sbyar ba'o/ /oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par byas/ slar yang hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca ku la sa pā ri wa ri ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/

shap+ta'i bar mchod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ /oṃ a bhi ṣīñca tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen por sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bha ba a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang ba'i bum pa'i dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan par bsams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum gyis bdud rtsi byin brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blang la lce thog tu gzhag pa'am/ gzhag par bsam la/ rang gi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po'i sbu gus myangs pas lus thams cad bde bas tshim par mos/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las lha mo brgyad spros ste/ rang gi byang chub kyi sems la sogs pas mchod par bsam la/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma ri ni smin 'dzin cing / /puk+ka si ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyi ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pa/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pas mchod/ rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa nyid/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces dang / brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /ye shes mda' gzhu ut+pal lcags kyu 'dzin/ /rje btsun rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ lha mo rnams rang gi snying khar thim par bsam la/

bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngang du sems 'dzin med du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par gzhag yi ge sngags rnams rnam par spangs/ /sgra dang thig le bsam du med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa nyid/ /ces bstod/ bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥdamar po'i mthar mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ zhes pas yi ge brgyad pa'i sngags phreng ba ltar dmar zhing mar me ltar 'od 'bar ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas klog pa'i tshul du bzlas par bya'o/ /skabs 'ga' rer 'di lta bu'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs phyogs bcur spros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal 'jig rten pa thams cad dang nor bu rin po che la sogs pa snod bcud kyi yon tan nus pa dang dpal 'byor legs tshogs thams cad 'od dmar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas/ khams gsum dbang du 'dus shing yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam la bzla/ dmigs bya ched du gtad pa yod na/ hrīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i sna la ku ru kul+le'i sku'i tshogs dpag tu med pa nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'phros pas bsgrub bya gang yin pa de lcags kyus snying gar btab/ mgrin par zhags pas bcings/ 'od dmar po'i drwa bar bcug nas rang gi rkang pa'i drung du 'gyel stabs su bzhag pas rang sems dang / de'i sems dbyer med du 'dres shing / myur bur la sogs rkyen brgyad spangs te/ tsan+dan dmar po'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pas bzla bar bya'o/ /de yang rgyun du ci rigs pa thun re la bzla ba'am bsnyen pa dngos la ni thun bzhir bcad/ thun gyi dngos gzhi la mi tshig gis bar ma chod par dmigs pa gong ma gnyis gang rung dang ldan pa'i 'bum phrag brgyad dam/

sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du bzla bar bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis sogs 'dod gsol spyi 'gre ltar/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ tshom bu/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ nam mkha'i khams su zhes pa nas/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le/ zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med par thim zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ dam rgya la brtan byed rnams mi dgos/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs rnams gong bzhin byas la/ mchod pa byin rlabs gnas yo ltar dang / mtshan sngags chu bzhi'i sngags dang / puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes sogs nyer spyod rol mo dang sngags rnams sbyar/ mthar dril bsil/ mtshan sngags la khrus bum sbyar ba'i nang mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags/ sogs yid byung dang bstod pa dril bsil gtor ma bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥs pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas lan gsum pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas par byas/ phyi yid byung gi mchod pa dang / bstod pa gong bzhin/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas mdun bskyed la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bar bsam/ bzlas pa bya ba'am/ ā nan+da'i rjes gnang gi yi ge las ma bshad pas ma byas kyang chog slob ma rnams khrus byas phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul te snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas/ rim gyis gral la 'khod/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de la 'dir sngon gyi dus su rgyal po lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pa zhes bya ba/ rgyal che zhing mtho ba gcig yin skad/ de la 'bangs 'khor g.yog dang btsun mo mang po yod pa las/

btsun mo gnang chen ma de'i rtsa ru rgyal po 'khor du ma 'dod pa las/ btsun mo des rang gi 'khor g.yog la rgyal po 'gugs pa'i rig pa tshong 'dus su song la tshol la shog ces bsgos pas bran mo des tshong 'dus rnams dang / bye brag tu skud pa 'tshong ba'i tshong 'dus su phyin pas/ bud med smug mo mdzes ma zhig la dris pas/ de 'dra'i rig pa yod zer bsnyad/ bud med de'i zhabs la 'jus nas rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas/ de'i gsung gis/ gang dmigs pa de la 'di byin gsungs nas za rgyu'i rigs gcig bskur bas/ des btsun mo la gtad de sngar bzhin skad pas/ btsun mo de'i bsam pa la/ 'di lta bu rgyal po la drangs na ma legs dog yod snyam nas/ ma drangs par pho brang gi rtsa ba la mtsho cig yod pa la bskur bas/ de'i nub mo nas mtsho de la yod pa'i klu'i rgyal po btsun mo'i rtsar byung nas/ rtse zhing dga' mgur spyod pa las/ dus su srog chags dang ldan par gyur nas rgyal po na re 'di'i rtsar ma phyin pas/ 'di chad pa zhig rigs zhes pas/ btsun mo des sngar gyi rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/ rgyal po des 'di re zhig brtags pa bya zhes zer nas/ sngar gyi bran mo de tshong 'dus su bud med smug mo 'tshol du btang bas bud med 'dug bsnyad/ de rgyal pos pho brang du gdan drangs nas yong bas/ rgyal pos dris pas/ de bcom ldan 'das ma'i sprul par shes nas zhabs la gtugs te rjes su bzung bar zhus pas/ des rjes su gdams shing byin gyis brlabs pas/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'grub ste slob dpon chen por gyur skad/ de lta bu'i slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pa de nyid nas rim par brgyud pa'i rje btsun ma'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ zhes sogs spyi 'gre ltar dang / tsan+dan dmar po'i chus byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po che sogs/

sh+lau ka gnyis kyis lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob dpon dang khyed rang gnyis ka ku ru kul+le zhal gcig zhes pa nas/ sa mā dzaḥ bar bdag bskyed tshogs zhing bzhin la sngags la phyag rgya dpon slob gnyis kas byed/ mchod pa sngags rgyas slob dpon kho nas bdag bskyed tshogs zhing ltar bya/ rgyun bshags kyi dmigs spos spyi 'gre ltar byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog bar rjes zlos lan gsum/ tshogs zhing rnams mdun bskyed la thim/ de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi sa bon las 'od byung nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la zhugs pas lus thams cad gang sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag nas 'od kyi phung por gyur/ de dmigs te slon dpon gyis/ shu n+ya ta nas/ yongs su gyur pa las bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun ma zhes pa nas/ dbus su hrīḥdamar po/ zhes pa'i bar bskyed bzhin/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis ku ru kul+le na bzhugs pa'i lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul nas 'od tshur 'dus pas dmar khrig khrig lus la zhugs lus thams cad dmar mer gyis khengs par spros/ snod bcud thams cad lha mor gyur/ de tshur 'dus khyed rang rnams la thim/ lho phyogs rig byed kyi phug dang / slon dpon las kyang rje btsun ma'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul tsam tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te/ khyed rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spyi 'gre ltar/ sngags dril bsil spos rol byas la/ de sku'i rjes su gnang ba yin/ gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i snying pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥ slob dpon gyi snying kha'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las sngags phreng mched/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod/ de yang sngags 'phreng dang pos sngar med gsar byung gi dam tshig pa bskyed/

gnyis pa ye shes pa bstim/ gsum pa dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'i thugs mos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum bya/ me tog slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum bya/ de gsung gi rjes gnang yin/ thugs kyi dngos grub gyi rjes gnang la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la sogs pa yon tan thams cad zhugs/ yang 'od 'phros pas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mthu dang nus pa bkug la thim/ yang 'od 'phros pas tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / dbang phyug dang / khyab 'jug la sogs pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyi nus mthu la sogs pa thams cad bstim/ yang 'od 'phros paṇ+ḍi ta dang rgyal po la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor thams cad khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥhrīḥ a be sha ya a be sha ya hrīḥhrīḥ zhes pa dang dril bu'i sgra res 'jog tu bya'o/ /des rje btsun ma'i thugs kyi rjes gnang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu rje btsun ma'i thugs dang khyed rang gi sems dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs/ de thugs kyi rjes gnang yin/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan pa yin pas sogs/ dam tshig bsdus te khas blangs pa/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas/ chos bsngo rnams spyi 'gre ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni mdun bskyed ltar mchod bstod byas la/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ brtan bzhugs/ gshegs bsdu/ gnas gsum srung ba/ bsngo smon/ shis brjod rnams skabs su bstun nas spyi 'gre ltar bya ba ni rig byed ma'i rjes gnang tshar lugs thun mong ba'o/

/thun mong ma yin pa ni gzhan rnams gong ltar las/ sbyor ba'i skabs su/ gtor ma pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du zan leb sgor mo/ de'i steng du zla gam bcad kha gdan ngos la gtan par gnang / dngos gzhi bdag mdun gnad yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun ltar la/ rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa'i zur 'debs gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i zhal snga nas kyi gsung ltar dang / slob ma'i bya ba la sems bskyed nas/ thugs kyi rjes gnang dril bsil rdzogs pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ de thugs kyi rjes gnang ste/ de dag gis nas dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim sngags dang thugs kyi byin rlabs 'jug pas na bum dbang gi don no/ /dbang gong ma gsum gyi don bsgom par bya ba'i phyir/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams lha mor gsal ba'i lte bar hrīḥdamar po las 'od dmar la dwangs pa'i me tog pad+ma'i skud pa 'dra ba'i phra ma dbu nas song / spyi bo'i haṃ la phog de nas thod pa'i nang gi dpral bar byung / g.yon bskor gyis rna ba g.yon ltag pa/ rna ba g.yas rnams rgyud phyir thon/ rna ba g.yas kyi rlung gis ut+pal la'i mda'i sbu gu nas song / rtse mos ut+pal la'i mde'u la phog pas kha bye/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi snying kha nas/ rnam shes kyi rten rlung dang thig le dbyer med hrīḥ'am hūm̐ gi rnam pa can la phog de 'od zer la hril gyis 'dus/ 'od zer thams cad tshur 'dus rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ lte ba'i hrīḥl thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la cung zad tsam re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de nas sems can thams cad kyi khams thig le rang la bsdus pa'i gsang dbang ngo / /de nas hrīḥlas 'od dbu mar yar cung zad byung bas lus sems bde hril ba la shes pa gtad de/ cung zad tsam re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ni bde ba'i ye shes bskyed pa ste shes rab ye shes sogs/

de dag gi don ngo sprod pa ni/ gang la thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang yod ma yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad stong pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / 'khor 'das gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'i mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par snang tsam dbyer mi phyed pa'i bde stong dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu snyam du nges par byas la shes pa khong lhod kyis glod la cung zad tsam mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ni bde stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod pa ste dbang bzhi pa'o/ /des na dbang sdud kyi dbang bzhi tshang ma dbang bskur gyi mthar spros bral la/ phug skyems ba 'di sa skya pa'i zab chos gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'bad med du 'grub pa zhig dgos/ de rnams kyi sgo nas zhes pa ni shis brjod kyi bar gong bzhin no/ /zhes rje btsun rig byed ma'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang kha'u brag rdzong pa'i phyag bzhes 'di nas ā nan+ta dang bud+dha shrī'i rjes gnang gi zin bris/ tshar chen rin po che'i sgrub thabs che chung rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyi dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang gsal byed/ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi bskyed rdzogs dmigs pa'i zur 'debs rnams gtso bor bzung / ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung rab nas kyang cung zad kha bskang ste don la rang bzo'i dri ma med par/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis rang dang skal mnyam zab mo'i don gnyer rnams kyi re skong du bris pa 'dis snyan brgyud zab mo'i bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
